signal: PR events use a synthetic merge commit as GITHUB_SHA, while the safety workflow's identity guard equated checkout HEAD to GITHUB_SHA and labeled that an exact-head check.
observed_scope: Static GitHub Actions workflow semantics and reproducible offline regression; no actual malicious PR or live cloud/broker incident observed.
direct_root_cause: Checkout did not select github.event.pull_request.head.sha and identity step did not compare against PR head SHA.
upstream_downstream: Misleading exact-head provenance could cause CI PASS claims to be attributed to a PR head that was never directly tested; push events already used correct github.sha.
prevention_hypothesis: Selecting PR head repo/SHA for pull_request events and asserting against expected head SHA, with push/dispatch fallback, prevents a merge-ref false-green identity check.

patch.rollback: Governed revert of PR #186; no force push.

evidence_chain.next_session_recurrence_check: Open a controlled PR targeting main or feat/cloud-paper-runner and verify pull_request workflow actually checks out event.pull_request.head.sha; record workflow job HEAD and compare with API head SHA. Also check future push branch triggers.

caveats: Static contract tests cannot prove a real pull_request event until such a run is observed.
No cloud deployment or market session was exercised.
